description: RFC 0002 owned-file inventory. Each record resolves a file to its current owner and its target module, with responsibility/effect/state classification, provenance, and symbol-level splits for mixed files.

coverage.note: Seeded from the RFC 0002 observed-evidence table plus the first geometry extraction candidate. Exhaustive per-file/per-symbol classification is the H0 exit condition and is tracked as HAM-INVENTORY-001; validator enforces full coverage only when status is 'complete'.

files.note: Common precompiled header pulls afxwin.h/afxext.h and Windows facilities. Removing a visible include does not establish portability; strict modules must not include this PCH.
CHammer combines MFC lifecycle and engine application-system composition. Bootstrap, service ownership, and UI lifetime need separate owners.

symbolSplits.note: MFC lifecycle retained on the legacy side of the seam.

files.note: CMapDoc derives from CDocument; editing state and operations cannot currently be instantiated independently of the MFC document layer.

symbolSplits.note: Mutations routed through the transaction boundary (HAM005).

files.note: Scene base exposes selection, rendering, transforms, persistence, and notifications. CMapAtom::SetParent accepts any parent; characterize the implicit base contract before extraction.

symbolSplits.note: Observed runtime-type narrowing vs CMapClass::SetParent; target API validates parent/child before mutation.

files.note: Broad base contract hides which behaviors each object actually supports; separate persistent content from render caches, UI state, and file encoding.
CSelection::SelectObject commits and invalidates property-dialog state; extracting selection must preserve the property-commit policy while removing the window dependency (HAM-SEL-001).

symbolSplits.note: Property-draft commit policy moves to the application layer; SaveData() coupling to the property sheet is removed.

files.note: CBaseTool has repeated 2D/3D/logical input entry points coupled to concrete view classes; normalize input and share gesture mechanics.
CMapView::GetViewWnd returns CWnd*; the current interface cannot serve an ordinary GTK or headless host. Split projection/picking/extraction from native window ownership.

IEditorTexture draws through CDC/RECT/CPalette; split asset metadata, decoded-image access, thumbnail generation, and private render bindings. Characterize GetImageWidth vs GetWidth before deduplication.

symbolSplits.note: Image vs mapping dimensions may differ; characterize before merge (do not treat the removal comment as evidence).

files.note: CVGuiWnd::DrawVGuiPanel passes native window handles into material-system views; native details must be confined to the private interop bridge.
CRender3D::BeginRenderHitTarget/EndRenderHitTarget convert object pointers to unsigned int and back; a 64-bit migration must replace pointer encoding with bounded pick identifiers (HAM009).

symbolSplits.note: GPU pick IDs index a frame-scoped table; they must not contain truncated object pointers.

files.note: Axis-aligned bounding box value type; depends only on mathlib/vector.h. First bounded geometry extraction candidate (HAM-GEOMETRY-001). Note the lone virtual IsIntersectingBox: characterize callers before deciding the extracted shape.
Implements BoundBox update/intersection/snap; extract with explicit grid/tolerance policy and preserve existing precision (HAM-GEOMETRY-001).
